aiCut.title: AI Cut
aiCut.description: Create an editable cut proposal for the current scene with OpenRouter.
aiCut.keyPresent: Key configured — enter a new key to replace it
aiCut.sessionKey: The system keyring is unavailable. Your key is kept only for this app session.
aiCut.encryptedKey: Your API key is stored encrypted using the system keyring.
aiCut.cleanupHelp: Suggest cuts for false starts, fillers, repeated takes and long pauses.
aiCut.tightenHelp: Also suggest redundant explanations to remove, while preserving important steps.
aiCut.customHelp: Describe what to shorten or remove. This version creates cuts within the current scene.
aiCut.instructions: For example: Shorten this tutorial to about five minutes and keep all important steps.
aiCut.privacy: Analysis sends the transcript, word times and your instruction to OpenRouter and the selected model provider. Audio and video stay local. Your OpenRouter account is billed for the request.
aiCut.configure: Set your OpenRouter API key and model first.
aiCut.truncated: The transcript is incomplete. Split this recording into shorter scenes before analysis.
aiCut.noSpeech: No speech was found in the current scene.
aiCut.noCuts: No cuts suggested. The scene has not been changed.
aiCut.sourcePreview: Source preview without editor effects. Check the final composition in the timeline after applying.
aiCut.undoHint: All selected cuts are applied as one undoable edit.
